At the 2026 ceremony, Femi, Yeni, Shalewa, and Kunle Kuti accepted the honour on his behalf. The Recording Academy recognised the Afrobeat pioneer’s global legacy alongside fellow honorees Whitney Houston and Chaka Khan.
